GOOD QUESTIONS

Clarity from
the first call.

Which destinations does Starta support?+

Reach and availability depend on the destination, use case, traffic profile and available commercial arrangements. Share your target markets so the team can confirm what is possible.

Can we discuss both messaging and voice?+

Yes. The current Starta offering includes global A2P SMS, wholesale voice and CPaaS discussions. Technical scope and commercial terms are confirmed per opportunity.

Can Starta accommodate an existing integration?+

Share your current setup and preferred connectivity method. Available protocols and onboarding requirements need to be confirmed before making an integration commitment.

How do we request pricing?+

Provide the destination, use case, estimated volume and any technical requirements. Pricing is quoted for the specific opportunity rather than advertised as a universal rate.
